title: Ordinary step at a non-call state
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c$ be a configuration whose state is $l$. If $P$ has no oracle call at $l$, then the register-program step from $c$ equals the ordinary machine step of $P$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: The program $P$ and oracle are given.
